title: Media Attendance at Incidents/Protocols
cross_references: Provision of Warnings to the Community

nodes.text: Media representative wishes to attend incident

evidence.source_text: Media representatives wishing to attend an incident are required to contact the control agency and attain permission to enter the fireground.

nodes.text: Contact control agency for permission to enter fireground

evidence.source_text: Media representatives wishing to attend an incident are required to contact the control agency and attain permission to enter the fireground.

nodes.text: Does media representative have current media accreditation card and approved PPE?

evidence.source_text: In order to work with fire agencies at bushfires, all media representatives are required to have: A current media accreditation card... Fire agency approved PPE...

nodes.text: Has Incident Controller deemed it safe and practicable for media to attend?

evidence.source_text: The Incident Controller will grant permission to attend the incident, particularly the fire ground, only if it has been deemed safe and practicable to do so...

nodes.text: Articulate specific conditions for media attendance

evidence.source_text: Upon deeming it safe and appropriate for media representatives to attend the incident, the control agency will articulate the specific conditions for that attendance...

nodes.text: Refer media representative to Public Information Officer or Media Officer

evidence.source_text: refer the media representative to the Public Information Officer or Media Officer.

nodes.text: Media Officer provides safety briefing and communication arrangements

evidence.source_text: The Media Officer will ensure that media representatives receive a safety briefing prior to entering the fire ground and that appropriate communication arrangements are in place.

nodes.text: Is media representative complying with instructions?

evidence.source_text: While on the fire ground, media representatives are required to comply with any instruction provided to them by the Media Officer, PIO, Incident Controller or Victoria Police.
Victoria Police Officers may remove media representatives from the fire ground who are endangering their own lives or the lives of others.

nodes.text: Media representative attends incident under specified conditions

evidence.source_text: Upon deeming it safe and appropriate for media representatives to attend the incident...
Media accreditation may be withdrawn and media representatives may be escorted from the fire ground and not permitted to return...

nodes.text: Ensure immediate departure from fireground if instructed

evidence.source_text: This includes immediate departure from the fire ground, should this be deemed a necessary safety measure.
